---
title: "Method Overview — Unified refresh loop"
---

## What — Inputs, outputs and modules

- No new method exists yet; this page describes the harness every policy plugs into.
- **Loop** [`src/methods/refresh/loop.py`](../../src/methods/refresh/loop.py): upstream's Fast-dLLM loop,
  with the refresh test delegated to a policy (token-identical to upstream, Exp 2).
- **Policies** [`src/methods/refresh/policies.py`](../../src/methods/refresh/policies.py):
  `FixedInterval(k)` (Fast-dLLM) and `Schedule(steps)` (static schedules, oracle).
- **Runner** [`src/scripts/run_campaign.py`](../../src/scripts/run_campaign.py): one model load, one task,
  many policies; one jsonl row per (arm, sample), resumable.

| Module | Input | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Policy | global step t, step within block i | refresh yes / no |
| Loop | prompt embeddings (N × 4096 hidden), policy, gen settings | answer tokens, per-step trace (refreshed, tokens decoded) |
| Runner | campaign json | generations.jsonl with time, forwards, refreshes, r |

## Why — What a refresh buys

- **Refresh step**: one forward over all N + gen_length positions; stores prompt keys and values.
- **Reuse step**: a forward over the current block only, attending to the stored prompt keys and values.
- With block = gen_length (captions), every answer position is recomputed at every step.
- So only the prompt's keys and values go stale: they were computed before the latest answer tokens existed.
- Bidirectional attention lets prompt states depend on answer tokens; that dependence is the error source.
- Cost per image (Exp 3, A100 80GB): refresh-every-step 48.3 s vs k = 32 6.3 s, at 111–114 forwards each.

## Candidate levers (from Obs 1)

| Lever | Evidence | Policy form |
|---|---|---|
| Refresh early steps densely | Divergence median at answer token 22 (k = 2); Spearman 0.75 with final agreement | `Schedule`: dense first m steps, sparse after |
| Refresh after many new tokens | Staleness = prompt not yet updated with new answer tokens | Trigger on tokens decoded since last refresh |
| Per-sample budget | Fragility rank-correlates 0.50–0.75 across k | Budget from a cheap fragility signal |

- Each lever is compared with fixed interval and same-budget random refresh before any claim.
